name: What factors should I consider when choosing an accessibility contractor?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing an accessibility contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an accessibility contractor, consider their experience with similar projects, their understanding of accessibility standards, and their local reputation. Look for contractors who offer clear communication, provide detailed proposals, and have positive client references. Verify they are licensed and insured in California. A good contractor will also discuss material options and provide solutions tailored to your specific needs and budget, ensuring a safe and functional outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider experience, knowledge of accessibility standards, local reputation, clear communication, detailed proposals, licensing, and insurance when choosing a contractor.
